data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Beginner · Lesson 4
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey, we're feeling free.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Sun's shining, let's go… El sol brilla, vamos
On this perfect day.

[Verse]
Waves are crashing, feet in the sand,
making friends with a wave of my hand.
What's up?… ¿Qué pasa?
Everything good?… ¿Todo bien?
Long time no see!… ¡Cuánto tiempo!
How's everything going?… ¿Cómo va todo?

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Sun's shining, let's go… El sol brilla, vamos
On this perfect day.

[Verse]
What a surprise!… ¡Qué sorpresa!
Nice to see you!… ¡Qué gusto verte!
What's new?… ¿Qué cuentas?
I've been good, can't complain.
What have you been up to?… ¿En qué andas?
Just enjoying the sun and the rain.

[Bridge]
Good morning… Buenos días
It's a brand new start.
With every hello… Con cada hola
We connect heart to heart.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Sun's shining, let's go… El sol brilla, vamos
On this perfect day.

[Outro]
Hey, we're feeling free.

vocab.en: What have you been up to?
